# Data import

```{r}
gs <- "url" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "fb") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:4), ~ as.factor(.))) 

fb %>% str()
```

# Traits

```{r}
traits <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "traits")

trait_label <- traits %>% 
  rename(fb = `{trait}`) %>% 
  mutate(trait = paste(variable, " (", units, ")", sep = "")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(fb, trait) %>% 
  distinct()

paleta_factor1 <- c(
"#1f78b4"
, "#f0027f"
, "#33a02c"
, "#6a3d9a"
, "#ff7f00"
  )

paleta_factor2 <- c(
"#fed976"
, "#feb24c"
, "#fd8d3c"
, "#fc4e2a"
, "#b10026"
  )

paleta_factor3 <- c("#e41a1c", "#a65628")
```

# Research Objectives

> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1u6xgTT8jDFkHSMkK1iRrNVR-1iOINQidbEiaDCu2Nqw/edit?gid=504037395#gid=504037395

## RO 1

```{r}
trait <- "trait1"

p_raw <- fb %>%
  plot_raw(
    x = "factor1",
    y = trait,
    group = "factor2"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ factor3)

print(p_raw)

model <- fb %>% 
  aov(trait ~ block + factor1*factor2*factor3)

av <- car::Anova(
  model,
  type = 3,
  test.statistic = "F")

mc <- av %>% 
  emmeans( ~ factor1 | factor2 | factor3 ) %>% 
  cld(Letters = letters, reversed = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(".group", trimws)) %>% 
  rename(sig = ".group")

plot <- mc %>%
  plot_smr(type = "bar"
    , x = "factor1"
    , y = "emmean"
    , group = "factor2"
    , sig = "sig"
    , ylab = trait
    , color = paleta_factor2
    # , xlab = ""
    # , glab = ""
  ) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ factor3, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = deframe(trait_label)[trait])
```

## RO 2

```{r}
dtx <- fb 
  
dtx %>% str()
 
traits <- names(dtx)[5:nrow(dtx)]

results <- purrr::map(
  traits, 
  \(trait) {

    gc()

    cat("\n\n## Análisis para:", trait, "\n\n")

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Exploración de los datos originales
    #--------------------------------------------------

    p_raw <- dtx %>%
      plot_raw(
        x = "factor1",
        y = trait,
        group = "factor2"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(. ~ factor3)

    print(p_raw)

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Modelo estadístico
    #--------------------------------------------------

    mdf <- reformulate(
      "1 + factor1 * factor2 * factor3 + (1 | block)",
      response = trait
    )

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Detección y eliminación de outliers
    #--------------------------------------------------

    md <- dtx %>%
      remove_outliers(
        mdf,
        plot_diag = TRUE,
        drop_na = TRUE
      )
    
    md$diagplot %>% print()

    dtc <- md %>%
      purrr::pluck(1, "clean")

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Datos después de remover outliers
    #--------------------------------------------------

    p_clean <- dtc %>%
      plot_raw(
        x = "factor1",
        y = trait,
        group = "factor2"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(. ~ factor3)

    print(p_clean)

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 6. ANOVA
    #--------------------------------------------------

    cat("\n### ANOVA\n\n")

    model <- md$model$clean

    aov <- car::Anova(
      model,
      type = 3,
      test.statistic = "F"
    )

    print(aov)

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Comparaciones múltiples
    #--------------------------------------------------

    cat("\n### Comparaciones múltiples (emmeans)\n\n")
    
    mc_i <- md$model$clean %>% emmeans( ~ factor1 |
                                          factor2 |
                                          factor3) %>% 
      cld(Letters = letters, reversed = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(across(".group", trimws)) %>%
      mutate(across(".group", tolower)) %>% 
      rename(sig_i = ".group")
    
    mc_o <- md$model$clean %>% emmeans( ~ factor2 |
                                          factor1 |
                                          factor3) %>% 
      cld(Letters = letters, reversed = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(across(".group", trimws)) %>% 
      mutate(across(".group", toupper)) %>% 
      rename(sig_o = ".group")
    
    mc <- merge(mc_i, mc_o) %>% 
      unite(col = "sig", c("sig_i", "sig_o"), sep = "") %>% 
      mutate(var = trait)
    
    mc %>% kable() %>% print()

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Gráfico resumen
    #--------------------------------------------------

    cat("\n### Gráfico resumen\n\n")

    plot <- mc %>%
      plot_smr(type = "line"
        , x = "factor1"
        , y = "emmean"
        , group = "factor2"
        , sig = "sig"
        , ylab = trait
        , color = paleta_factor2
        # , xlab = ""
        # , glab = ""
      ) +
      facet_wrap(. ~ factor3, scales = "free")  +
      labs(y = deframe(trait_label)[trait])

    print(plot)

    #--------------------------------------------------
    # 9. Resultado
    #--------------------------------------------------

    list(
      trait = trait
      , model = model
      , data_clean = dtc
      , anova = aov
      , emmeans = emm
      , mc = mc
      , plot = plot
    )
  }
) %>%
  purrr::set_names(traits)

dt_merge <- map(results_int, "mc") %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(factor1, factor2),
    names_from = var,
    values_from = emmean
  ) 
```

```{r}
plots <- map(results, "plot")

grid <- list(
  plots$var1
  , plots$var2
  , plots$var3
  , plots$var4
  ) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto")

fig <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/Figure-1.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 20
         , height = 20)

fig %>% include_graphics()
```

# Multivariate Analysis

```{r}
#| eval: false

library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)

dtx <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c("factorX", "factorY")) %>% 
  unite("rowname", c("factor1", "factor2"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  column_to_rownames() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

str(dtx)

#> Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
  
mv <- dtx %>% 
  PCA(scale.unit = T
      , graph = F
      , quali.sup = c(1, 2))

var <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("var"), cex=0.7)

var

cos <- mv %>% 
  fviz_pca_var(col.var = "cos2"
               , gradient.cols = inti:::paleta()
               , repel = TRUE
               , labelsize = 2)

cos

ind <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("ind")
           , cex = 0.7
           , label = "ind"
           , invisible = "quali"
           , col.hab = inti:::paleta()
           , habillage = "none"
           )

ind

#> PCA info

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")

#> Hierarchical Clustering on Principle Components (HCPC)

cls <- mv %>% HCPC(nb.clust = -1, graph = FALSE)

plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE)

map <- \() {plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE)}

#> HCPC info

cls$call$t$tree
cls$data.clust %>% 
  kable(caption = "Cluster membership of each individual")  
cls$desc.var$quanti %>% 
  kable(caption = "Quantitative variables characterizing each cluster")
cls$desc.var$category%>% 
  kable(caption = "Categorical variables significantly by cluster")  
table(cls$data.clust$clust) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Number of individuals assigned to each cluster")

#> multivariate plot

fig <- list(var, cos, ind, map) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto") %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/multivariate.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 30, height = 30)

fig %>% include_graphics()
```

## Multivariate graphical information

```{r}
#> Percentage of explained variances

c1 <- fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels = TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill="white",
                barcolor ="darkblue",
                linecolor ="red") + 
  # ylim(0, 30) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c1

#> Dim 1 - variables contribution

c2 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c2

#> Dim 2 - variables contribution

c3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c3

lpanel <- c(c1, c2, c3) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, labels = "auto"
            , rel_heights = c(1, 1.2, 1.2))

#> Variables correlation

rpanel <- \() {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    tl.cex = 0.9, 
    number.cex = 0.5, 
    number.digits = 1,
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4 
  )

}

grid <- c(lpanel, rpanel) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = c("", "d"))

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/contribution.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 20, height = 30)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```
